Verified domain functionhealth.com (Austin consumer health labs/MRI membership). Series A Jun 2024 led by a16z brought cumulative funding to $53M (Series A size itself not separately disclosed). Oversubscribed $298M Series B Nov 2025 led by Redpoint at $2.5B valuation; Seedcamp invested via Select Fund after Function acquired Seedcamp Day-One portfolio company Ezra. Public equity total treated as $53M (through Series A) + $298M Series B = $351M.
